items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... [INTERVIEWEE] Good morning, Monk.

ctx.x: Good morning. We are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. My name is Monk Rowe. It’s our great pleasure today to have with us bassist and avid golfer, Mr. Keter Betts.
This is the earliest interview we’ve done.
